channel.title: Portage, MI - News Flash
channel.description: Portage, MI - Get the latest news

item.title: Fall Fest Cancelled due to Threat of Inclement Weather
item.description: Fall Fest has been cancelled for today, Saturday, September 19, due to the threat of inclement weather in the forecast.

item.title: Boil Water Advisory Lifted Effective September 10, 2026
item.description: The boil water advisory that went into effect on September 8, 2026, for 6742 – 6852 Windemere Street, 1412 and 1420 Hardwick Avenue, and 6852 Greenview Avenue has been lifted.

item.title: City Council Appoints Karen Dempsey-Horan as Portage City Manager
item.description: The Portage City Council appointed Karen Dempsey-Horan as the next City Manager for the City of Portage during its September 8 meeting.

item.title: Plan Ahead To Vote
item.description: Are you planning to vote in the November 3 Election and travel out of state for the winter or head to college in the fall?

item.title: Secretary of State Mailer
item.description: Heads up, Portage! We want you to be aware that the State of Michigan will be sending out a voter registration mailer starting September 8, 2026.

item.title: The Portage Bike Committee Presents PORTAGE P3 on Sunday, September 13
item.description: Families, cyclists, and outdoor enthusiasts are invited to join the fun at Portage P3 (Parks Poker Pedal), a new regional biking event presented by the Portage Bike Committee.

item.title: West Centre Avenue Road Construction: Oakland Drive to Shaver Road
item.description: On Tuesday, September 8, 2026, starting at 9 AM, traffic on West Centre Avenue will shift to the two south lanes of the roadway in preparation for milling and paving on the north side of West Centre Avenue.

item.title: Online Parks & Recreation Guide
item.description: Ready to #ExplorePortageParks and experience the unique programs and events Portage Parks & Recreation offers? The 2026 - 2027 Fall & Winter Parks & Recreation Guide is now available online!

item.title: Portage City Council Selects Karen Dempsey-Horan to Begin City Manager Contract Negotiations
item.description: The Portage City Council selected Karen Dempsey-Horan on Friday, August 28, as the candidate with whom the city will begin contract negotiations for the City Manager position.

item.title: Line Dancing - Register Now!
item.description: Join Portage Parks & Recreation for line dancing at Schrier Park. Registration is now Open!

item.title: TEENS Earn-A-Bike - Register Now!
item.description: Teens, are you ready to gear up to learn the fundamentals of fixing your bike?

item.title: Heartless takes the Stage at the last Summer Concert Series of the Season
item.description: Join Portage Parks & Recreation on Thursday, August 27 at 7 PM for an unforgettable evening with Heartless as they take you on a musical journey of Heart’s greatest hits at Overlander Bandshell, 7810 Shaver Road.
